demos.name: Privilege Rate Limit LAB
demos.description: A refilling bucket, an in-flight cap, a limit shared across a gateway cluster and the app-wide MCP and A2A caps, on a lab clock: seven scenarios with a chart and a verdict. Simulated; only four features are sourced from the release notes, the rest is UNVERIFIED.
demos.notes: Port 7837 and catalog id D000 are PROVISIONAL placeholders: the owner assigns the real ones at the shelf registry step. Host-run: npm start (port 7837). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock only; makes zero outbound calls.
